summary: Max allowed duration between the related steps (seconds).
businessRules: max_duration defines: This attribute is effective only when precedence type relation is used. max_duration restricts the travel time of the vehicle to go from location of first task to the location of second task specif…
Must stay consistent with: relations.min_duration. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: cap the gap between a pickup and its delivery.
Infeasible: max_duration smaller than the unavoidable gap -> tasks unassigned.
